rules.title: Recognition rules
rules.hint: Rules are evaluated before category keywords and AI, in priority order (highest first): the first one matching the description (and the sign, if set) assigns the category and, if chosen, destination/person, and immediately confirms the transaction.

form.isRegexHint: If off, the pattern just needs to be contained in the description (case-insensitive). If on, it's treated as a regex.
form.priorityHint: On equal match, the rule with the highest priority wins.
